title: Formspec Common Schema Primitives
description: Shared schema definitions used by Formspec Definition, Theme, and Component documents.

url.description: Canonical URL of the target Definition.

compatibleVersions.description: Semver range expression describing which Definition versions this document supports.

Tokens.description: Flat design token map. Keys are dot-delimited names; values are strings or numbers.

Breakpoints.description: Named viewport breakpoints. Values are minimum viewport widths in pixels.

contactType.description: Open vocabulary: 'customer support', 'accessibility', 'language line', etc. Renderers SHOULD honor 'customer support' as default.

LangMap.description: Language-keyed string map (BCP 47 keys). JSON-LD-compatible with @container: '@language'.

Party.description: Shared base for entities that publish or issue Formspec documents. Issuer and Publisher both extend Party.

name.description: Display name. Plain string or LangMap.

identifier.description: Stable entity URI - ROR, Wikidata, DID, or own-domain URL.

homepage.description: Public organizational homepage (distinct from any document URL).

StyleMap.description: Flat style map. Values may contain $token.path references.

Extensions.description: Extension object whose keys must be prefixed with x-.

ValueClass.description: Shared origin class for response values and respondent-ledger changes. Closed-core values mirror respondent-ledger-event.schema.json ChangeSetEntry.valueClass; module-contributed extensions use the x-* registry lane.

AccessibilityBlock.description: Accessibility overrides applied to a rendered element.

background.description: Container background token or renderer value.

border.description: Container border token or renderer value.

radius.description: Container corner radius token or renderer value.

elevation.description: Container elevation token or renderer value.

CustomWidgetName.description: Custom widget identifier. Custom widgets must use the x- prefix.

ModuleRef.description: Canonical module reference per ADR 0150 §4.4. Used by document `modules[]` (§4.3), `posture.allowedModules[]` (§4.4), `bundle-manifest.modules[]` (§5.2), and `module.dependencies[]` (§4.1).

id.description: Module ID following the Registry naming pattern per ADR 0150 §4.8. Despite §4.4 prose calling this a 'URN', §4.3 examples and §4.8 regex are bare `^x-` prefix (e.g. 'x-formspec-core-task'). This pattern matches the canonical regex.

version.description: Strict SemVer string or range expression (e.g. '1.0.0', '^1.0.0', '>=1.0.0 <2.0.0').

publisher.description: OPTIONAL provenance assertion (the document asserts; posture admission checks).

lockHash.description: OPTIONAL digest pin (e.g. 'sha256:...'). Pins hostile-substitution risk when paired with posture.allowedModules[].

AuthorActor.description: Authoring identity per ADR 0150 §5.4. Distinct from `respondent-ledger-event.Actor` (respondent-identity) and `experience.Actor` (workflow-role) — three Actor $defs by design. `kind` and `actChannel` are terminal-closed enums; product nuance (e.g. discriminating Wireframes-MCP from Forms-MCP, both `actChannel: 'mcp'`) rides URN-encoded into `id`, not via new enum values.

id.description: Stable actor URN (urn:formspec:actor:... scheme). Product nuance rides URN-encoded (e.g. urn:formspec:actor:mcp:wireframes:agent-7).

kind.description: Terminal-closed per §5.4 (NOT §4.5-extensible). Answers 'what kind of authoring entity'.

actChannel.description: Terminal-closed per §5.4. Orthogonal to kind. Answers 'through what channel'. An ai-agent MAY have actChannel:'mcp' (mediated via MCP) OR 'agent' (autonomous). A human MAY have actChannel:'human' (direct editor) OR 'mcp' (CLI-driven MCP).

display.description: Optional human-readable label for timeline/support views.

SessionRef.description: App Manifest session index entry per ADR 0150 §5.5. App Manifest carries `sessions: SessionRef[]` as the durable list of sessions held against the app; each entry is a temporal grouping with the act-record in the ledger via `respondent-ledger.sessionRefs[]` referencing this URN.

actors.description: URN refs into the App Manifest's actor list.

Generation.description: Generalized x-generation provenance carrier per ADR 0150 §5.3/§5.4. SUPERSET of the existing inline x-generation shape at component.schema.json:240-282 — every pre-existing field (source, strategy, generatedBy, generatedAt, anchors) remains valid; new fields (sourceModule, movedFrom, copiedFrom) layered on top. `generatedBy` migrates from free-form string to `oneOf [string, AuthorActor]` for backward compatibility while enabling structured authoring identity. `additionalProperties` stays open (no false) so tool-layer use is unconstrained beyond the documented superset.

source.description: Existing field (component.schema.json:256-259): generator source label, such as an Experience Unit, prompt, template, or generator input bundle. Preserved as-is.

strategy.description: Existing field (component.schema.json:260-263): generator strategy identifier, such as unit-to-section or a host-defined strategy name. Preserved as-is.

generatedAt.description: Existing field (component.schema.json:268-271): generation timestamp. Authors SHOULD use an RFC 3339 date-time string. Preserved as-is.

anchors.description: Existing field (component.schema.json:272-279): source anchors with a standard prefix and source-layer-owned suffix. Preserves original `^(item|unit|task|action|concept):.+$` items pattern enforcement.

generatedBy.description: Actor attribution per §5.4. Migration-friendly: pre-existing free-form string values (e.g. 'component-generator/1.0.0') continue to validate; new authoring stamps the full AuthorActor inline.

sourceModule.description: Module/template provenance per §5.3. Orthogonal to generatedBy — answers 'which module supplied this template' not 'who authored this op'.

movedFrom.description: Set by tooling on cross-Component move per §5.3. Graph-wide provenance uses ComponentNodeIdentityRef; CrossComponentRef is retained only as same-runtime compatibility evidence.

copiedFrom.description: Set by tooling on cross-Component copy per §5.3. Graph-wide provenance uses ComponentNodeIdentityRef; CrossComponentRef is retained only as same-runtime compatibility evidence.

ComponentNodeIdentityRef.description: Graph-wide Component node identity for x-generation movedFrom/copiedFrom provenance. Mirrors the app-graph Component node identity tuple: Component membership, Surface sibling identity, route, absolute route-scoped nodePath, and optional public/structural node ids. This is provenance metadata only; it does not authorize, execute, or resolve runtime behavior.

url.description: Canonical URL of the Component document when available.

version.description: Component document version evidence when available.

url.description: Canonical URL of the Surface document.

version.description: Surface document version evidence when available.

route.description: Surface routes[].id for the route-scoped node.

nodePath.description: Absolute route-scoped Component node path built from stable node segments.

id.description: Optional ComponentBase.id evidence for the node.

nodeId.description: Optional structural authoring identity for the node.

CrossComponentRef.description: Legacy same-runtime route + intra-document node path. Retained for Studio/kernel compatibility; it is not sufficient graph-wide Component provenance once multiple Surfaces or Component documents are loaded.
